reviewer_identity.interpretation: Independent model/service/source review; not user or external ChatGPT acceptance.

reproduction.dependency_audit_scope: Python file-open/subprocess audit for launcher workers and postprocessing; compiler and service command provenance checked separately. Locked native upstream remains required source. Not an OS-wide syscall trace.

resolved_source_findings.issue: RRAM1bit RowDecoder phase selection had numNand=numNor=0 but unconditional MUX timing; missing area/caps
resolved_source_findings.resolution: Replaced by explicit complementary INV selection with real load/RC and area; final verify includes sticky lane mismatch, phase reduction and bounded failure semantics.

resolved_source_findings.issue: MUX enableNAND serial resistance / real driver predecessor capacitance and NOR fanin consistency
resolved_source_findings.resolution: Actual NAND2 seriesR, driver input cap and actual NOR fanin used in canonical patches.

resolved_source_findings.issue: Odd address predecoder INV ignored direct NOR fanout, severe for512word staging
resolved_source_findings.resolution: Source Power fanout reused as max input INV load; existing serial native chain disclosed as conservative envelope, not exact STA. Independent original C++ probe preserved.

resolved_source_findings.issue: ACIM second external input capture lacked a held-input contract
resolved_source_findings.resolution: One external capture with input register retained across both passes; phase/selection costs retained.

resolved_source_findings.issue: RRAM final reduction area changed after layout iteration; prior components exceeded reported envelope12–14%
resolved_source_findings.resolution: Every iteration and final pass reconstruct tree/correction/routes; actual sum fits fixed-rule square footprint in all three temperatures.

resolved_source_findings.issue: Shared Bus direction and many D-pin endpoint loads lacked physical identity
resolved_source_findings.resolution: 16read and16write directional32bit point links, hub mux, explicit root/bank/staging2INV drivers and actual pin/wire caps installed; external writeport remains32bit.

resolved_source_findings.issue: Declared logical shape/precision and arbitrary overrides could look authoritative without supported consumption
resolved_source_findings.resolution: Fixed256x31 INT8 enforced, unknown overrides rejected, actual request/constructor/native thermal fields and causal consumers independently audited.

ns_sram_acim: 256-row stock parallel SRAM read stability and calibrated transfer remain unverified.
Nominal9bit ADC capacity and25bit result container are not measured ENOB.
ns_rram_1t1r: Generic8k/24k RRAM +5k access and1V10ns programming are model reference inputs, not a jointly measured22nm material pack.
Requires stiff read rail, nominal calibrated ADC gain and successful bounded program-verify; failure does not publish compute-ready.

Q4 is a preserved representation. Full-positive error4.30/4.69/5.08%, zero-exact signed-cancel residual16891/762/889, and mixed-vector max relative error11.625/4.78125/2.80208 prevent an exact-INT8 or weak-signal accuracy claim.
Linear ladder/first-order ADC settling omit stochastic variability, nonlinear access I-V, ADC noise, ENOB and extracted layout.
ns_sram_dcim: Exact nominal digital mapping is verified; native SRAM/clock abstractions are not transistor or clock-tree signoff.
common: 300/350/400K are finite fixed-architecture design scenarios, with native resizing.350K is warm reference, not a statistical median or one-chip PVT.
Native SAR time formulas remain temperature-independent. The thermal range does not cover material uncertainty.
Stable external rails, local macro ports, mutually exclusive read/write, native DFF/reset/enable abstraction; no optimal-throughput, equal-area or general workload accuracy ranking.

rejected_candidate_claim.claim: V3 ideal two-codes/count half-up subtraction must incur multiactive +/-1LSB error
rejected_candidate_claim.review_conclusion: False for unclipped ideal linear transfer: Q(a+2m)-Q(a)=2m. Fractional baseline alone is not an integer-algebra defect. The actual issue is distributed resistance and fixed codes not being a generic changed-input interface.

coverage_interpretation: Named checks demonstrate these native input/service/resource/geometry dependencies and selected numerical mechanisms. Assertion counts are not physical model coverage, ENOB, Monte-Carlo confidence, or application accuracy.
